Explain Siri Shortcut, Invocation Phrase & Prediction Eligibility in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

Siri Shortcut - A saved action that the user can start by voice or from the Shortcuts app.
한국어: Siri Shortcut: 음성이나 단축어 앱에서 사용자가 시작할 수 있도록 저장해 둔 동작

Invocation Phrase - The short phrase a user says to Siri to start a saved action.

Prediction Eligibility - A setting that lets Siri suggest an activity to the user at a useful moment.
한국어: Prediction Eligibility: Siri가 적절한 순간에 사용자에게 활동을 제안할 수 있게 하는 설정

landscape.hook: Can you explain Siri Shortcut, Invocation Phrase and Prediction Eligibility in English?

dialogue.title: Order coffee by voice
dialogue.setting: Adding Siri support to the order screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, can users order coffee from our app without opening it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, offer a Siri shortcut. A Siri shortcut is a saved action that runs by voice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do we create it from the code?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the activity `a`, and call `becomeCurrent` when the user places an order.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And what does the user say to run the Siri shortcut?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The invocation phrase. In our code, it is Order coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can we choose any invocation phrase?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, but keep it short and easy to say.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will Siri suggest the shortcut on its own?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only with prediction eligibility. Set `isEligibleForPrediction` to true.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So prediction eligibility lets Siri suggest it at a useful moment?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. The user sees the suggestion and adds the Siri shortcut with one tap.

dialogue.code:
import Intents
let a = NSUserActivity(activityType: "x.order")
a.isEligibleForPrediction = true
a.suggestedInvocationPhrase = "Order coffee"
a.becomeCurrent()
